changelog: Orbit 1.4 now actually creates and edits files in your workspace — no more pasting code from chat
Reliable offline tool use even on smaller models (larger context window + tolerant tool-call parsing)
Universal macOS build — one download runs natively on Apple Silicon and Intel
Fully offline / air-gapped — your code never leaves your machine
Automatically runs the most capable model your hardware can handle
Cloud providers (Claude, GPT, Gemini) are opt-in and off by default
